name: SubmitMatic

sources.title: Submit page — 'Log in to Submit… Log in with Google'; submitting a tool to the directory requires a Google sign-in
Directory — 165+ tools across 40 categories; listings show name, blurb, category, pricing model
Pricing — done-for-you service: $60 (60+ dirs) / $100 (100+) / $140 (140+), 2-business-day turnaround, Google Sheet report

conditions: Listing your tool on submitmatic.com's own directory requires signing in with a Google account — no anonymous/email path
Whether the self-directory listing is free could not be fully verified past the login wall — the site's prominent paid offer is a separate done-for-you submission service ($60-$140)
requirements: Google account sign-in to access the submit form
Tool/startup fit for their category taxonomy (Productivity, AI Assistants, Software, Marketing, SEO, Dev Tools, etc.)
Site's main business is paid directory submission — expect upsell, but a direct listing likely exists behind login
preparation: Tool name, URL, short blurb, category, pricing model (listings carry Free/Freemium/Free Trial/Paid tags)
workflow: Open https://submitmatic.com/submit and sign in with Google
Complete the tool submission form (fields hidden behind login — inspect in browser)
Verify the listing lands under /tool/<slug> in the directory
Ignore the $60-$140 '140+ directories' DFY pitch unless you actually want their done-for-you service
watchFor: Two different offers share this domain: the directory listing (the launchdesk target) vs a paid done-for-you submission service — don't conflate them
Payment links go through dodopayments.com checkout; anything priced $60/$100/$140 is the DFY service, not the listing
Their FAQ admits they use 'smart automation' for submissions and a shared Google account for some sign-ins — irrelevant for a self-listing but relevant if you ever buy the service
Listings include some NSFW-adjacent tools — assess neighbor quality
countsAsLive: A public /tool/<slug> page exists on submitmatic.com and the tool is searchable in the /tools directory
unknowns: Whether the directory listing itself costs money (form is behind login)
Review process and approval time for direct submissions
